definitions.explanation: A relatively small physical distance. Used for travel, communication, combat, and other contexts involving proximity.

examples.japanese: {近距離|きんきょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧だ。
{近距離|きんきょり}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo from close range.

examples.japanese: {近距離|きんきょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しなら⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: If it's a short-distance move, you might be able to do it yourself.

notes:
{近距離|きんきょり} indicates a short or close-range distance. A compound of {近|きん} (near) + ⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧ (distance). Commonly used as a modifier before nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近距離|きんきょり}⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧: short-distance commute
- {近距離|きんきょり}⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧: relationship with someone nearby (vs long-distance)
- {近距離|きんきょり}⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧: close-range attack
- {近距離|きんきょり}⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧: short-range wireless
- {近距離|きんきょり}{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: short-distance move

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧: long distance (opposite)
- ⟦{中距離|ちゅうきょり}→中距離：22985_chuukyori⟧: medium distance
- ⟦{短距離|たんきょり}→短距離：09270_tankyori⟧: short distance (more commonly used for races and sprints)
